cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I leave for my shift, how much lasagne will you save me? Family custom says 'a proper portion.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll leave you a box. You decide what 'proper' means when it's for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will my box be full when I get home, or just whatever they leave?
